project.title: Nhật Minh Quá Oai - Chiếc Răng Sữa Thứ Hai
project.visual_style: photorealistic cinematic children's music video, warm natural skin tones, bright but believable environments, colorful child-friendly production design, high visual energy, expressive reactions, realistic lighting, shallow depth of field where appropriate
important_instructions: Generate every scene in landscape 16:9 widescreen.
Fill the entire frame naturally with the environment.
No portrait composition, no vertical framing, no black bars, no borders, no letterboxing, no pillarboxing.
Keep @NhatMinh visually consistent in every scene.
Keep the same face, hairstyle and main outfit unless the prompt explicitly adds a police-inspired costume.
Keep @NhatMinh as the main visual focus while using the full horizontal frame.
Use cinematic wide shots, medium shots, tracking shots, dolly moves, camera orbits and dynamic transitions.
Use environmental details on both sides of the character to create depth and a true widescreen composition.
Do not generate subtitles, captions, logos or text inside the video.
Do not generate dialogue. The final Suno audio track will be added during editing.
All scenes must remain playful, innocent, energetic and suitable for a children's music video.

generation_rules.realism: Photorealistic live-action look. Natural human movement, realistic anatomy, realistic skin, hair, fabric, shadows and reflections. Avoid plastic CGI appearance.
generation_rules.child_visual_engagement: Use clear focal points, colorful moving elements, playful reveals, rhythmic action, expressive reactions, confetti, bubbles, sparkles and safe fantasy transitions without overcrowding the frame.
generation_rules.character_consistency: Always use @NhatMinh as the same child character. Preserve face, hairstyle, age appearance, body proportions and identity across all scenes.
generation_rules.camera_consistency: Use smooth physically plausible camera movement. Avoid sudden teleporting, impossible lens movement, excessive shaking or random cuts.
generation_rules.continuity: The ending pose, screen position, movement direction, costume and important props of one scene should logically connect to the next scene whenever possible.
generation_rules.safety: No blood, frightening dental imagery, dangerous behavior, weapons, aggressive police action or distress.
generation_rules.frame: Landscape 16:9 full screen. No black bars, borders, letterboxing, pillarboxing, subtitles, captions or logos.
